prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Scope: warehouse receiving to outbound load release. Elements: Yard Gate Controller=Velvetrook (records vehicle/carrier/trailer/arrival; validates vs receiving plan; flags unscheduled; directs to door; uses Trailer Seal Exception Note; blocks risky vehicles; recovery: holds vehicles outside boundary). Inbound Inspection Desk=Cinderbay (checks paperwork/seals; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note; records proceed/rework/hold; records governance approval, confirms config under change control). Pallet Dimension Scanner=Moonquarry (produces Oversize Load Advisory; flags out-of-tolerance; never authorizes rule-violating placement). Inbound Pallet Buffer (staging). North/South Aisle Stacker Crane (North=Juniperwake: sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot to WMS; uses Slot Reservation Receipt; receives Crane Service Release Card as return-to-service authorization after checks; stops on obstruction). East/West Transfer Conveyor (interlocked; East restart: one empty reduced-speed cycle, recorded). Conveyor Line Controller=Brasshaven (produces Transfer Induction Ticket; inhibits feed on unsafe conditions; closing: verifies zones clear). Autonomous Forklift Fleet=Larkspur (receives Transfer Induction Ticket; sends Forklift Handoff Confirmation to WMS, which closes movement record; parks in approved locations, reports restrictions). Outbound Dispatch Sorter (receives Dispatch Wave Amendment). Outbound Checkweigh Scale (sends Gross Weight Variance Slip to Shipping Documentation Desk, which reconciles vs shipment record; out-of-tolerance resolved before release). Safety Zone Controller, Fire Alarm Panel (Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice). Maintenance Release Terminal=Copperfield (sends Crane Service Release Card; records service; restrictions visible until cleared). Warehouse Management System=Morrowglass: authoritative; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment; closes commissioning register only when findings have owners/dates. Actor: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (shift-start review; confirms acceptance evidence; reviews emergency changes). Modes: commissioning acceptance (approved test plan, representative loads, withheld on material safety/inventory/shipment defect); normal; recovery (aisle restricted, staged resumption); shift handover (outgoing records restrictions, incoming acknowledges before movement). Requirements: no work without WMS release; unique task ref; held pallets separated; crane unavailable until checks pass; changes need impact review, approval, controlled record. KPIs: throughput, availability, exceptions.

New part:
S240: Operational performance and recurring faults are reviewed at a defined cadence using retained acceptance and maintenance records.
S241: The review assigns corrective actions with accountable owners, target dates, and evidence of closure.
S242: Training is updated when a change affects operator duties, alarm response, or equipment recovery procedures.
S243: The outgoing shift records remaining restrictions and unresolved concerns, and the incoming shift acknowledges them before authorizing routine movements.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
